description: Registry of Soft Body simulations and experiments.

cloth_simulation.name: Cloth Simulation
cloth_simulation.description: Soft body physics simulation using spring-mass systems

flagdancer.name: Flag Dancer
flagdancer.description: Animated soft body flag that waves and dances using cloth physics simulation with wind forces.

softbody3d.name: SoftBody 3D
softbody3d.description: Core soft body physics demonstration using Godot's SoftBody3D node for deformable mesh simulation.

squishy_ball_pit.name: Squishy Ball Pit
squishy_ball_pit.description: A glass container filled with squishy, glowing soft body spheres.

soft_trampoline.name: Soft Trampoline
soft_trampoline.description: A large, bouncy soft body sheet pinned at the edges.

breathing_room.name: Breathing Room
breathing_room.description: A corridor with soft body walls that rhythmically expand and contract.

soft_mushrooms.name: Soft Mushrooms
soft_mushrooms.description: Procedurally generated mushrooms with wobbly soft body caps.

cloth_straps.name: Cloth Straps
cloth_straps.description: Hanging soft body cloth straps that the player can walk through.

revolving_joy_ride.name: Revolving Joy Ride
revolving_joy_ride.description: A rotating ride with hanging soft bodies colliding with obstacles.

pendulum_slap.name: Pendulum Slap
pendulum_slap.description: A double pendulum that slaps soft bodies.

softbody_gallery_part1.name: SoftBody Gallery Part 1
softbody_gallery_part1.description: Part 1 of the soft body test gallery.

softbody_gallery_part2.name: SoftBody Gallery Part 2
softbody_gallery_part2.description: Part 2 of the soft body test gallery.

softbody_gallery_part3.name: SoftBody Gallery Part 3
softbody_gallery_part3.description: Part 3 of the soft body test gallery.

rounded_softbody_test.name: Rounded SoftBody — Strain Energy
rounded_softbody_test.description: Deformable rounded cube with 3 modes: strain energy heatmap coloring by vertex displacement, collision-response force arrows with impact bursts, and volume preservation with real-time ratio chart. VR hand squeeze interaction pushes vertices. ImmediateMesh overlays for all visualizations.

jelly_cube.name: Jelly Cube
jelly_cube.description: A soft, deformable cube that jiggles when touched. VR-enabled with physics parameter controls for stiffness, damping, and pressure.
jelly_cube.qfep_connection: Low stiffness = high Î» territory. Form becomes fluid, resists fixed categories.

frozen_glass_vessel.name: Frozen Glass Vessel
frozen_glass_vessel.description: Walkable glass vessel whose shape emerged from physics, not design. Sphere + top-pin ring + pre-inflation pulse + gravity + N settle steps = a drooping amphora, long bottle, wide bowl, or slumped vase depending on force balance. The clock is part of the genome — duration as design parameter. Walkable twin of gl01_classic_bulb from the soft-body gallery.

spring_node_toy.name: Spring Node Toy (the atom of a soft body)
spring_node_toy.description: A held two-mass-one-spring: the spring pulls toward its rest length. A soft body is just this, many times over.

mass_spring_bench.name: Mass-Spring Bench (a shape nobody specified)
mass_spring_bench.description: A grid of masses and springs settling on a bench - each spring pulling to rest length, the whole finding a shape nobody specified.

verlet_workbench.name: Verlet Workbench (constraints that hold themselves)
verlet_workbench.description: A cloth relaxing under a Verlet integrator with a constraint-pass dial - integrate position from position, and the constraints hold without ever being solved.

pressure_dome_room.name: Pressure Dome Room (pushing out, pulling back)
pressure_dome_room.description: A room-scale pressurised soft dome you stand under: internal pressure pushing out against strain energy pulling back - a balance held, not a skeleton imposed.

elasticity_press.name: Elasticity Press (strain energy, stored and returned)
elasticity_press.description: A press squeezing a soft block, a strain-energy readout climbing as it compresses and springing back on release.

descent_marble_toy.name: Descent Marble Toy (finding a shape is rolling downhill)
descent_marble_toy.description: A held marble-in-a-bowl rolling down to its minimum: finding a shape is rolling downhill on an energy landscape.

energy_landscape_bench.name: Energy Landscape Bench (height is energy)
energy_landscape_bench.description: A soft body settling on a wavy energy-landscape surface where height is energy, descending into the nearest basin.

max_q_basin_room.name: Max-Q Basin Room (the liveliest minimum)
max_q_basin_room.description: A room with a deep narrow DEAD well (rigid, one shape) and a shallow wide ALIVE well (soft, a shape it keeps re-finding). Max Q is the liveliest minimum, not the deepest.

gradient_descent_optimizer.name: Gradient Descent Optimizer (the bridge to learning)
gradient_descent_optimizer.description: A soft body descending an energy landscape toward max Q with a step/energy readout - the same motion as training a model. Soft bodies are gradient descent you can poke.

jelly_room.name: Jelly Room (push it, it forgets)
jelly_room.description: A room of wobbling jelly pillars you walk among: push it and it pushes back, then forgets - elastic deformation, the body that returns to itself.

cloth_loom.name: Cloth Loom (all surface, no inside)
cloth_loom.description: A loom draping a flag or sail under gravity and breeze - cloth is the simplest soft body, all surface and no inside, learning to fold from its own weight.

bounce_egg_toy.name: Bounce Egg Toy (store it, give it back)
bounce_egg_toy.description: A held squishy egg that bounces and squashes: store the impact in the springs and give it back.

bounce_arena_room.name: Bounce Arena Room (bounce instead of break)
bounce_arena_room.description: A room-scale bounce arena of trampolines and soft pillars - the joy of a body that bounces instead of breaking.

viscous_bench.name: Viscous Bench (where soft becomes fluid)
viscous_bench.description: A bench of viscous blobs oozing, merging, slumping - turn down the stiffness and the soft body starts to flow.

lava_lamp_tool.name: Lava Lamp Tool (viscosity as a tool)
lava_lamp_tool.description: A lava-lamp device: viscous blobs rising and falling in a glass column on a heat loop - viscosity put to use.

membrane_toy.name: Membrane Toy (an inside, and a way across)
membrane_toy.description: A held lipid-bilayer patch that lets a particle cross: the boundary that makes an inside while letting the world across.

membrane_bench.name: Membrane Bench (the Markov blanket made flesh)
membrane_bench.description: A selectively-permeable membrane on a bench: small particles cross, big ones bounce - the Markov blanket made flesh, the edge an organism holds by exchanging.

membrane_filter.name: Membrane Filter (the boundary as a tool)
membrane_filter.description: A membrane as a dialysis filter: mixed particles in, only some pass, sorted out the other side.

breathing_toy.name: Breathing Toy (a boundary that holds by moving)
breathing_toy.description: A held breathing sac that swells and shrinks - a boundary that holds its shape only by moving.

breathing_hall_room.name: Breathing Hall Room (it could burst)
breathing_hall_room.description: A room whose soft walls and columns breathe - bulging in and out around you. It breathes, it bulges, it could burst.

pressure_valve_tool.name: Pressure Valve Tool (the abject, regulated)
pressure_valve_tool.description: A valve regulating a breathing soft body: a gauge, the body swelling until released - the abject boundary as a regulated tool.

miura_press.name: Miura Press (a solid packed into a line)
miura_press.description: A press folding a flat sheet into a Miura-ori packed solid and back - the crease pattern that packs a map, a solar array, a wing into a line.

folding_menagerie_room.name: Folding Menagerie Room (walks by folding)
folding_menagerie_room.description: A room of folding creatures unfolding and re-folding, each moving by changing its shape - structure that walks by folding, not by pushing against bone.

octopus_bench.name: Octopus Bench (no bone, all middle)
octopus_bench.description: An octopus arm curling and coiling on a bench, suckers along its length - distributed soft cognition, no bone.

octopus_room.name: Octopus Room (the queer body)
octopus_room.description: A room-scale octopus: a soft mantle, eight curling arms, colour-shifting skin. No skeleton, not a puddle - the queer body par excellence.

rigidity_toy.name: Rigidity Toy (the alive middle)
rigidity_toy.description: Crystal, soft blob, puddle side by side - only the middle breathes. Rigid is dead, fluid is dead; soft is the only state that holds a form and still flows.

rigidity_dial_bench.name: Rigidity Dial Bench (sweep the stiffness)
rigidity_dial_bench.description: A row of bodies swept along a stiffness dial - crystal (frozen) through soft (alive) to puddle (slumped). The pointer rides to the live middle.

lambda_edge_room.name: Lambda-Edge Room (made flesh)
lambda_edge_room.description: A rigid crystalline wall on one side, a fluid pool on the other, and the soft alive forms breathing in the band between. You stand in the lambda_edge made flesh.

aliveness_meter.name: Aliveness Meter (peaks in the middle)
aliveness_meter.description: A meter reading how alive a body is by where it sits on the rigid-fluid axis - the needle peaks in the soft middle and drops to dead at both ends.

abject_toy.name: Abject Toy (won't stay inside its line)
abject_toy.description: A held abject blob that troubles its own boundary - a membrane that bulges and weeps a droplet, never quite staying bounded.

abject_bench.name: Abject Bench (softness as a feeling)
abject_bench.description: A soft body that leaks across its boundary - drips, seeps, reaches past its edge, pulls back. Abjection as a generative force; softness as a feeling.

abject_room.name: Abject Room (inside and out)
abject_room.description: A room of the abject: membranes leaking, boundaries troubled, soft forms reaching past their edges - the edge that troubles the line between inside and out.

becoming_toy.name: Becoming Toy (form emerges)
becoming_toy.description: A held scatter of particles drifting from noise into a coherent shape and back - form is not imposed, it emerges.

becoming_bench.name: Becoming Bench (entropy becoming morphology)
becoming_bench.description: A field of particles settling from disorder into an organized form - entropy becoming morphology.

self_shaping_forge.name: Self-Shaping Forge (the thesis made flesh)
self_shaping_forge.description: A forge where raw matter descends toward max Q, its liveliest form, and emerges - the project's thesis made flesh: gradient descent toward the shape that persists by moving.
